_comment: The minimum an instance needs before it can take a case, declared once and read live.
NOT in src/manifest.json, though the change asked for it there: the v2 app-manifest schema
sets additionalProperties:false at the top level and on the setup block, in all three copies
vendored copy synced in ConductionNL/.github#776). A readiness key added to the manifest
would fail validate-manifest.js and gate 22 on the day it shipped. Carrying the readiness
block in the manifest needs a nextcloud-vue schema change first, which is the follow-up.
Each item names the screen an administrator goes to in order to satisfy it. The declared
list and the list SetupController reports agree in both directions, asserted by
SetupDeclaredMatchesReportedTest: an item rendered but never reported cannot be answered,
and an item reported that no screen satisfies cannot be acted on.

items.title: An organisation
items.body: Cases, documents and calendars all hang off an organisation. OpenRegister holds it.

items.title: A mail account
items.body: Pick the shared mailbox the app sends from and reads case mail out of.

items.title: A published case type
items.body: Every case follows a case type. A draft type takes no cases.

items.title: A role someone holds
items.body: A role with nobody in it decides nothing. Give at least one role a holder.

items.title: A working calendar
items.body: Terms are counted in working days. Without a calendar every deadline is a guess.
